title: RSVP collaborative BCI dataset from Zheng et al 2020
description: A collaborative brain-computer interface dataset based on rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) paradigm, comprising synchronized EEG recordings from 14 healthy subjects (7 pairs) performing target image detection tasks. This is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the original dataset published by Zheng et al. 2020. The dataset includes 62-channel EEG data sampled at 1000 Hz across 2 sessions per subject, with event-related potential (ERP) markers for target and non-target visual stimuli, designed to support BCI research and benchmarking studies.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuroscan Synamps2 system at 1000 Hz sampling rate from 62 electrodes positioned according to the standard 10-20 montage with vertex (Cz) reference. Subjects performed RSVP-based target detection tasks involving human vs. non-human image classification with 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Data were collected across 2 sessions per subject with 3 runs per session, yielding 168 target and 4032 non-target trials per subject.
